She put in motion all the tests and checks and I have been seen very quickly. Thank you DOCTER. Respect.

On Wednesday 5 Nov I attended  the  Lime’s for an ECG and was seen by Nurse Charlie. She was very helpful and clear. Also cheerful and polite. Thank you Charlie.
